text:
ravi: Morning async standup — quick status from me. What I did: cleaned up stale prewarm jobs in staging, pushed autoscaler fix (PR #4987) that reduces overreactive scale-ups. Blockers: seeing a weird spot reclaim pattern in apac last night — a few nodes got reclaimed in short bursts. Today: rolling 4987 to canary, watching apac, will coordinate with cloudops if quota needs bump.

jamie: Thanks. I checked with @cloudops — account has a small cushion but we can request +10 GPUs in apac if we justify it. I’ll open the ticket and link the usage graphs. will ping if they need more detail. :thumbsup:

sophia: Ran a quick lane heatmap this AM — most lanes <60% but gpu-queue-12 spikes to ~78% for short bursts. Left a note on the ticket with sample times. Quick check command I ran: `kubectl top pods -n gpu-queue --no-headers | sort -k3 -nr`

maria: LGTM on PR #4987, left one tiny comment about a log message. Also turned on the eu-west1->eu-west3 reroute rule yesterday, should help p95 for that region.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary deploy of autoscaler v2 to pool-tilt-canary. CI: ✅ all checks passed.

ravi: Nice — once canary is healthy (watching logs + p95) I'll promote. If anyone sees sustained >75% for 10m, please tag #incidents and mention the oncall. Jamie — pls paste the cloudops ticket link when created so we have an audit trail.

jamie: Will do. Opening ticket now and attaching the sample window + cost delta. ETA to have a reply: ~2-4h. Off to run a smoke test in apac; will report back here if I hit the reclaim pattern.

sophia: If we need quick diagnostics, I'll leave a tiny script in /ops/tools to tail KV cache pressure and pod events. Ping me and I’ll run it.

maria: Also, small FYI — I saw a flaky test in the scale tests related to node drain ordering; filed a follow-up issue (#5391) so it won't block rollout.

ravi: great notes, everyone. no further blockers from me.
